model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC percentage across seven different conditions. The x-axis represents Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale, spanning from approximately 1 to 5,000 with irregularly spaced tick labels. The y-axis represents ACC percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 40% to 65%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different condition: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The Base condition, depicted by a black solid line with circular markers, starts at around 39% and increases to approximately 43%. The FT condition, represented by a blue solid line with triangular markers, begins at around 41% and rises to about 48%. The IKE condition, shown as a red solid line with triangular markers, starts at approximately 43% and increases to around 50%. The MEND condition, illustrated by a brown solid line with circular markers, begins at around 44% and rises to about 56%. The MEMIT condition, depicted by a purple solid line with circular markers, starts at approximately 45% and increases to around 54%. The ROME condition, represented by a green solid line with triangular markers, begins at around 52% and rises to about 65%.
